metadata.ffmpeg_version: 7.1-essentials_build-www.gyan.dev built with gcc 14.2.0 (Rev1, Built by MSYS2 project)

technical_scan.note: Technical signals only. Continuous visual review and user approval remain separate.

image_scale_note: Common constant near-proportional raster scale; rounding 920px height introduces <0.1% ratio difference. No subject tracking.
informational_change: Front to side-facing torso views add sleeve and dress outline; bags partly obscure shirt side.
actual_turn_note: More side-facing than requested 30 degrees; angle not calibrated. A turns earlier than B.
synchronization: Common start only; no forced gesture phase
output_clock: Explicit native 24fps timebase and encoder frame rate; source frame selection unchanged.
transition_rule: Any future switch needs approximately 0.75s dissolve.
assistant_sampled_review: Root source25+face5 per look, sourceA f72 and B f84/f108 originals, output5 checkpoints and B critical f84 checked; independent source/output review recorded separately.

user_approval.user_reply: 恩 ，不錯。一開始兩邊沒有同步轉身，但是再看第二次後反而覺得不錯
user_approval.context: Direct feedback on the complete6s angle-v2 preview. User explicitly mentions a second viewing.
user_approval.scope: This exact independent research cut, including its native staggered turns.

user_feedback.first_impression: Noticed the sides did not turn synchronously.
user_feedback.second_impression: Felt the result was good after looking again.

user_approval.action_timing_decision: Retain the native A-earlier/B-later turns; do not retime to synchronize this accepted cut.

sampled_limitations: B tote obscures lower shirt side; A bag partly obscures side.
